Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy

Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy.Enemy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Damageable, Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
MeleeEnemy, RatNest
public abstract class Enemy extends Character
Every enemy and boss (GDD 1.3.1). Its gdx-ai state machine decides what it does each tick (GDD 1.7); each family fixes how it attacks in attackTarget(com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) and how far in canReach(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character). Its values come from data/characters.json (Q93) through the CharacterFactory.

Pattern: State (EnemyState on the gdx-ai state machine) and Template Method (attackTarget(com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) and canReach(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character) are the hooks each family fills).

  • Constructor Details

    • Enemy

      protected Enemy(EnemySetup setup, Attack baseAttack)
      Creates an enemy. It starts EnemyState.IDLE, with no target.
      Parameters:
      setup - what every enemy is built from: its body (also its hurtbox), stats, invincibility ticks after a hit, summoned flag (a summoned enemy never drops loot, Q16), sprite and world; must not be null
      baseAttack - its natural attack; must not be null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if setup, a value of it or baseAttack is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the invincibility ticks are negative

    • canSee

      public boolean canSee(Character target)

    • alert

      public void alert(Character target)
      Gives this enemy a target it chases anywhere on the map: the signal sent to an area's enemies when the player enters it (Q51), or an arena wave rushing the player. A target it cannot see (dead, or on its own side) is ignored.
      Parameters:
      target - the character to chase
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if target is null

      protected abstract void attackTarget(World world)

    • readState

      public void readState(StateBuffer in)
      Puts back what writeState(com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.StateBuffer) wrote, in the same order. The AI state is set without its enter and exit steps: a rewind puts the enemy back, it does not make it decide anything.
      Specified by:
      readState in interface Rewindable
      Overrides:
      readState in class Character
      Parameters:
      in - the photo being restored
